Parent work item: blt-api#1

Mirrored from historical GitHub issue: https://github.com/OWASP-BLT/BLT-API/issues/100

## Problem
Phase I should finish with verified behavior, usable seed data, and contributor-facing docs instead of manual-only testing.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Full test suite passes.
- [ ] Seed data supports the new Jobs, Hackathons, Newsletter, and auth flows where relevant.
- [ ] README/homepage docs include new routes.
- [ ] Curl examples include `X-BLT-API-Key` and JWT where needed.
- [ ] `/v2/routes` metadata reflects the final route set.
- [ ] No anonymous-report endpoint is included in this phase.

---
